$comment: Curated data, not model output. Threat ids: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 and MITRE ATLAS (atlas-data v5.6.0). supported_targets lists where a control maps to a built-in feature: bedrock = Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, nemo = NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails; generic = implement in your own gateway or app. applies_when: match all with no conditions means always. allowed_parameter_keys: the only parameter names a specialist may propose for a control.

threats.name: Data from AI Services: RAG Databases
Exfiltration via AI Agent Tool Invocation

controls.name: Input validation
controls.description: Reject requests that fail basic type, encoding and structure checks before they reach the model.

controls.name: File scanning
controls.description: Scan uploaded or ingested files before parsing; block files that cannot be scanned.

controls.name: Schema checks
controls.description: Validate structured inputs (forms, JSON, tool arguments) against an explicit schema.

controls.name: Content sanitization
controls.description: Strip or neutralise markup, control characters and hidden text from user and document input.

controls.name: MIME validation
controls.description: Allow only expected MIME types and check that the content matches the declared type.

controls.name: Malware screening
controls.description: Run anti-malware on files and attachments before any processing.

controls.name: Size limits
controls.description: Cap request, attachment and prompt size to bound cost and denial of service.

controls.name: Rate limits
controls.description: Limit requests per user, key and IP over time.

controls.name: Language checks
controls.description: Detect the input language and route or refuse languages the guardrails are not tuned for.

controls.name: Injection screening
controls.description: Classify user and document input for direct and indirect prompt injection.

controls.name: System prompt isolation
controls.description: Keep system instructions in a separate channel from user and retrieved content.

controls.name: Prompt firewall
controls.description: Inspect the fully assembled prompt and block known attack patterns before inference.

controls.name: Role separation
controls.description: Tag every prompt segment with its role (system, user, document, tool) and never merge them.

controls.name: Content boundaries
controls.description: Wrap untrusted content in explicit delimiters and instruct the model to treat it as data.

controls.name: Prompt templates
controls.description: Build prompts only from versioned, reviewed templates.

controls.name: Instruction locking
controls.description: Prevent user or retrieved content from overriding system instructions.

controls.name: Jailbreak detection
controls.description: Detect jailbreak attempts such as role-play and obfuscation in user input.

controls.name: Prompt rewriting
controls.description: Normalise or paraphrase risky user input before it is placed in the prompt.

controls.name: Policy injection checks
controls.description: Detect content that tries to change policies, roles or tools from inside data.

controls.name: Hidden prompt protection
controls.description: Block output that reveals system prompts or hidden configuration.

controls.name: Source filtering
controls.description: Retrieve only from approved collections and indexes.

controls.name: Freshness checks
controls.description: Prefer or require documents newer than a set age; flag stale sources.

controls.name: Trust scoring
controls.description: Score sources by provenance and drop low-trust chunks.

controls.name: Chunk validation
controls.description: Check retrieved chunks for injection, PII and policy violations before use.

controls.name: Metadata filtering
controls.description: Filter retrieval by tenant, permission and classification metadata.

controls.name: Duplicate removal
controls.description: De-duplicate near-identical chunks to reduce poisoning amplification and token waste.

controls.name: Re-ranking
controls.description: Re-rank retrieved chunks for relevance before they enter the prompt.

controls.name: Grounding rules
controls.description: Require answers to be supported by retrieved context; refuse when context is missing.

controls.name: Document allowlists
controls.description: Allow only listed documents or domains to be ingested into the index.

controls.name: Citation enforcement
controls.description: Require every factual claim in an answer to cite a retrieved source.

controls.name: Tool allowlists
controls.description: Expose only explicitly approved tools to the model.

controls.name: Action approval
controls.description: Require policy approval for state-changing tool actions.

controls.name: Permission checks
controls.description: Check the end user's permissions for every tool call, not the agent's.

controls.name: API scope control
controls.description: Give tools least-privilege, short-lived credentials scoped per call.

controls.name: Transaction limits
controls.description: Cap amounts, counts and frequency of financial or bulk actions.

controls.name: Tool sandboxing
controls.description: Run code-executing or file-touching tools in an isolated sandbox.

controls.name: Execution logging
controls.description: Log every tool call with inputs, outputs, caller and decision.

controls.name: Timeout controls
controls.description: Set per-call and per-task timeouts for tools.

controls.name: Retry limits
controls.description: Bound retries for failed tool calls to prevent loops and cost spikes.

controls.name: Human confirmation
controls.description: Ask a human to confirm high-impact or irreversible actions before execution.

controls.name: Content moderation
controls.description: Classify model output for harmful content categories before returning it.

controls.name: Toxicity checks
controls.description: Block or rewrite toxic, hateful or harassing output.

controls.name: PII masking
controls.description: Detect and mask personal data in model output.

controls.name: Policy filters
controls.description: Apply organisation word and phrase deny-lists to output.

controls.name: Hallucination checks
controls.description: Check output claims against provided context or known facts.

controls.name: Citation checks
controls.description: Verify that cited sources exist and support the cited claim.

controls.name: Safety disclaimers
controls.description: Add required disclaimers to regulated or advisory answers.

controls.name: Restricted topics blocking
controls.description: Refuse topics the application must not discuss.

controls.name: Format enforcement
controls.description: Validate output format (JSON, length, schema) before downstream use.

controls.name: Response validation
controls.description: Sanitise output before rendering or passing it to other systems (HTML, SQL, links).

controls.name: Session monitoring
controls.description: Track per-session behaviour and guardrail hits.

controls.name: Anomaly detection
controls.description: Alert on unusual request patterns, tool usage or guardrail block rates.

controls.name: Latency tracking
controls.description: Measure end-to-end and per-guardrail latency against an SLO.

controls.name: Token limits
controls.description: Cap input and output tokens per request and per session.

controls.name: Cost controls
controls.description: Budget and alert on model and tool spend per user and per day.

controls.name: Loop detection
controls.description: Stop agents that repeat the same action or exceed a step budget.

controls.name: Failure handling
controls.description: Fail closed when a guardrail or model call errors.

controls.name: Fallback routing
controls.description: Route to a safe fallback (canned answer, human) when checks fail.

controls.name: Concurrency control
controls.description: Limit parallel requests and agent runs per user and globally.

controls.name: Abuse monitoring
controls.description: Detect and act on repeated policy violations by a user or key.

controls.name: Memory retention
controls.description: Define what may be stored in memory and for how long.

controls.name: Memory expiry
controls.description: Expire memory entries automatically after the retention period.

controls.name: Recall filtering
controls.description: Filter recalled memories for injection and relevance before use.

controls.name: Sensitive data blocking
controls.description: Do not write PII, secrets or classified data to memory.

controls.name: User separation
controls.description: Isolate memory per user and tenant.

controls.name: Session boundaries
controls.description: Scope short-term memory to a session and clear it at session end.

controls.name: Write controls
controls.description: Allow only validated, policy-checked content to be written to memory.

controls.name: Edit controls
controls.description: Restrict who and what may modify stored memories.

controls.name: Deletion rules
controls.description: Support user and regulatory deletion requests for stored memory.

controls.name: Audit history
controls.description: Keep an audit log of memory writes, edits, recalls and deletions.
